text_block_list.text: On this day, Student Council duties had piled up since morning, and seeing how visibly exhausted Symboli Rudolf was, I decided to let her rest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm not as tired as you make it out to be,
though I do have more meetings in the afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I shall take a brief nap
to prepare for the work ahead.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, where am I?
I thought I was just in the infirmary a moment ago...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I've seen that somewhere... Wait, could it be the Three Goddesses!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To think they truly existed is astonishing.
They say if you dream of the Three Goddesses, your wish comes true, but—

Then, as if hearing Symboli Rudolf's voice,
the Three Goddesses slowly approached.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I have no need for that.
Dreams are something you seize with your own hands.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Even if you're goddesses,
I stand on my own two feet. I have no intention of relying on anyone's power!"

Hearing those words,
the Three Goddesses offered a quiet smile.
In that instant, a dazzling light enveloped the area—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Hm, a dream after all, was it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even so, my body feels light.
Taking a break was definitely the right call.
Afterward, having seemingly shaken off her fatigue, Symboli Rudolf took on her afternoon duties in top form.

Hearing those words,
the Three Goddesses gave a quiet nod.
In that instant, a dazzling light enveloped the area—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What a strange dream that was.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now then, time to get on with the afternoon work—
Looking out the window, it was already dark outside.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what a disaster...!
I completely overslept, what a blunder!
